title: Ensure inactive users are reviewed and removed periodically
description: An account nobody uses is an account nobody notices being used. Dormant credentials with repository access are a standing invitation, and they also consume licences.
remediation: Administration -> Users: for each listed account, either deactivate it or remove the grants that give it repository access. Where accounts come from an external directory, disable them there — Bitbucket will follow. Adjust the window with thresholds.inactiveUserDays in scm-bench's config.
remediationZh: 管理后台 -> Users：对列出的账号，或停用，或移除其仓库访问授权。若账号来自外部目录（LDAP/AD/Crowd），应在目录侧停用，Bitbucket 会同步。判定窗口可通过 scm-bench 配置项 thresholds.inactiveUserDays 调整。
